scope: Proposition 6.7 of the manuscript “The Bogomolov-Pop reconstruction theorem” (preprints/The-Bogomolov-Pop-reconstruction-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d805627401fffef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The point inertia lines of every curve subfield E are precisely the saturations of the nonzero images ρE(Iv) for divisorial valuations v of K/k. The correspondence of Theorem 6.1 preserves these lines and the genus. In particular, it matches exactly the relatively algebraically closed rational subfields. If Θ( b E) = b P, the induced continuous isomorphism φE : WP → WE makes the diagram WL WK WP WE φ ρP ρE φE (14) commute and matches the point inertia lines on its targets. For rational E and P, these are the geometric rational quotient diagrams, with their point decomposition data.
